Esta tabela resume as aulas 19 a 37. Rel: This table summarizes lessons 19 to 37. Reread one row at a time and say an example of your own out loud. If something looks odd, go back to the lesson indicated or open the topic in the Grammar tab.
radical do «nous» + «-ais, -ais, -ait, -: stem of «nous» + «-ais, -ais, -ait, -ions, -iez, -aient»; habits, setting, age and time in the past; «être» → «ét-».
imparfait = cenário; passé composé = aco: imparfait = setting; passé composé = event; an action in progress that is interrupted: «Je mangeais quand tu as appelé».
«lui, leur»; «écouter/attendre» = direto: «lui, leur»; «écouter/attendre» = direct; «le lui», «me le»; affirmative imperative: «donne-le-moi».
infinitivo + «-ai, -as, -a, -ons, -ez, -: infinitive + «-ai, -as, -a, -ons, -ez, -ont»; irregulars: «ser-, aur-, ir-, fer-, pourr-»; «quand» + future; «si» + present.
Tempo: depuis, il y a, pendant, dans, ve: Time: depuis, il y a, pendant, dans, venir de
«depuis» + presente (continua); «il y a»: «depuis» + present (still going on); «il y a» + passé composé (finished); «venir de» (just did); «être en train de».
radical do futuro + «-ais…»; pedidos edu: future stem + «-ais…»; polite requests; «si» + imparfait + conditional; advice: «à ta place, je…».
pedidos educados em hotel, aeroporto, te: polite requests at the hotel, airport, on the phone, by email, when renting, at the bank and post office.
entonação, «est-ce que», inversão; «qu'e: intonation, «est-ce que», inversion; «qu'est-ce qui/que»; «parce que», «donc», «pourtant», «grâce à», «à cause de».
«voir, croire, connaître, mettre, écrire: «voir, croire, connaître, mettre, écrire, lire, dire»; «connaître» × «savoir»; the participle agrees with a direct object that comes before.

Mon premier mois à Lyon / Meu primeiro m: Mon premier mois à Lyon / My first month in Lyon
Há um mês, deixei o Brasil para trabalha: A month ago, I left Brazil to work in Lyon. When I arrived, it was raining and I was very tired, but my colleague was waiting for me at the station. Since then, I have been working at a bank and living in a small apartment near the metro. At first, I didn't know anyone. Now I have several friends and we go out every weekend. Yesterday we went to the cinema. The film we saw was very funny. If all goes well, I will stay here for two years and learn to cook French dishes.
Carlos and Julie arrange to meet.
— Alô, Julie? É o Carlos. Você está livr: — Hello, Julie? It's Carlos. Are you free on Saturday evening?
— Que tal jantar? Conheço um bom restaur: — How about dinner? I know a good restaurant near my place.
— Por volta das vinte horas. Acabei de r: — Around eight o'clock. I just booked a table. You won't be late, will you?
— Não, estarei na hora. Se eu tivesse o: — No, I'll be on time. If I had your address, I would come and pick you up.
